Absolutely, we’ve got you. Here’s a quick roadmap to help you choose:

How to try us: You can sample our food first with a Variety Pack from Chewy or Amazon, or single packs at PetSmart to see what your pup likes.
Life stage: All our recipes work for puppies through seniors, and we automatically adjust portions as your dog grows.
Activity level & portions: When you create a profile, you’ll choose your dog’s activity level so we can size portions correctly. Your exact portions and feeding guide will always be visible in your online account.
Health needs: If your dog has allergies or medical issues (like kidney disease, liver disease, pancreatitis, or urinary stones), we recommend talking with your vet first, since we don’t offer prescription, low‑fat, low‑sodium, or hydrolyzed diets.
How the subscription works: You’ll start with a two‑week trial based on your dog’s health goals. After that, orders ship every four weeks, and you can change recipes, delivery, or cancel anytime before the order deadline.
Where to buy: Besides subscriptions on our site, our meals are also available online via PetSmart, Amazon, and Chewy, plus select PetSmart stores.

Based on all that, the “right” choice is usually: sample a couple recipes via Variety Pack or PetSmart singles, see what your dog loves, then set up a subscription with their age, weight, and activity level so we can portion everything for you.

I'd like to stay within a sensible budget, what are my best options?
Totally get wanting to keep costs sensible—feeding your pup shouldn’t break the bank.
Here are your best budget‑friendly options:
Try before subscribing: Get a Variety Pack from Chewy or Amazon, or single packs at PetSmart to see what your dog loves without committing to a full subscription.
Shop retail instead of subscribing: You can buy all 6 of our recipes online through PetSmart, Amazon, and Chewy, and in select PetSmart stores. This lets you control quantity and timing, which can help with budgeting.
Request a tailored quote: Since subscription pricing depends on your dog’s details (age, weight, activity level, recipes, and your ZIP for tax), you can share that info with our Pet Support team and they’ll provide a personalized cost estimate so you can decide if it fits your budget.
Look into discounts: If you’re a First Responder or Military Veteran, you can apply for a discount on Nom Nom orders through our Pet Support team.
Use the trial wisely: Our meal plan starts with a two‑week trial before the regular 4‑week subscription cadence kicks in, so you can evaluate value and adjust or cancel before future orders if needed.
Based only on this info, your best budget moves are: start with retail Variety/solo packs, then—if your dog loves them—get a personalized quote and see if any discounts apply before committing to a subscription.
